script.cover_1: One mistake in a report. One text goes to the whole group.
script.payoff: Private feedback with the exact fix and a time corrects the work and keeps the person.
script.caption: Fixing the error and shaming the person are different jobs. Send this to the one who corrects people in front of everyone.
script.request: A mistake in a report needs to be corrected.
script.pushy: Everyone look at this mistake. So careless.
script.professional: Messaging you privately about an error in the report. Fix by 4 pm?
script.why: It corrects the work in private and names the exact fix and time.
script.reply_me: Sorry about the error. Fixing it by 4 pm. Can feedback come privately next time?
